description.text: Objective: Through one semester study, students could improve Chinese skills in a short time and achieve relevant HSK certificate. Courses: Chinese Pronunciation, Chinsese Vocabulary, Chinese Grammar, Chinese Reading and Listening, HSK Reading, HSK Writing, HSK Listening, HSK Oral Test, Chinese Daily Conversation etc. Notes: The program will open if the number of applicants are over 10 or above. It could accept group and individual registration. Group class could decide the study content and study time.

duration.text: The HSK Training Program at Ludong University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1111 USD/per semester ￥ 8000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate of HSK If applicable. Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test), No need for English medium programs

requirements.text: (Applicants must be) non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport (Applicants must) Be in good health Applicants for advanced programs should have HSK Level 4 or above (Applicants should be between the) age of 10 to 60
